reason: NONE. What I noticed first was the sachet box with the QR and 'Every batch lab-tested', which is nice, but there are zero reviews and I don't buy anything I take daily without hundreds of them, so I can't check the 1-star complaints about stomach and fake dosing.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't see whether anyone got stomach trouble or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim until strangers confirm it. Also the Complex has citrate in it, which gives me cramps, so I'd rule that one out right away.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred verified reviews with a solid average and few complaints about stomach upset or dosing, or a way to try a small pack first for less.
